Record Class BlockTransformer

java.lang.Object

net.minestom.server.instance.block.transformer.BlockTransformer
Record Components:
transforms - the transforms in the order they are tried, must not be empty
public record BlockTransformer(List<BlockTransformer.BlockTransformData> transforms) extends Record
How an item turns one block into another when used on it, such as a shovel making a dirt path.
